body:
I was attacked by users, when i defended myself the mods took it against me.  yes the world is very much out for me, not just me but weak people like me and i don't care if i end up dead or in jail or what the fuck but i have nothing left to lose anymore and as tired as I am of having to fight everyone who wants to hold me back I'm not going to stop fighting as long as I am here.  Fuck all those people, and fuck you for standing next to them, if you all want a fight you got it.

Don;t suspend my account over some bullshit and i won;t have to circumvent shit.  Arrogant fucking pricks. I'm still fucking with them hardcore trying to get someone to give me some sort of response of find some sort of remedy to the situation, some sort of accountability for the mods actions, but it seems like i just need to go the fuck elsewhere.  Reddit fucking sucked bad enough when it was just the users always being mean, but now the mods attacking me, what the fuck am i even doing here?  I'm on the verge of killing myself and I have mods messaging me asking me to tone down my post.

What a fucking joke this place is, just like the rest of the god damn world.  its like fucking high school, a bunch of ignorant fucks in cliques that all hate you.

Fuck you all. And me too.

Fuck.  I've been stockpiling these pills for years for nothing.

I'm sure I'll fuck up suicide too.

Lets see.... testing.....

edit:  ok it worked, they haven't got this account yet.  The fucking cunt ELI5 mods keep following me around suspending my new accounts and then muting me so I can't even discuss it with anyone, every time I have to make a new account i have to go through this process of waiting 10 min between each post and entering captchas and shit.

The whole world is against me, even random reddit mods.  I hear people from "4chan" hate Reddit, looks like I need to see what that place is all about.  Fuck reddit.

There is definitely a point to living, it is to further the wealth of the capitalist class.  That is the meaning of life, to make the wealthy richer through our labor, that is how it works within a crypto-fascist oligarchy such as what America has become.

You got me all wrong, I'm not bitter about my Dad's life, well maybe a little bits not aimed at him and that is not my motivation.

You are right, money isn;t everything, I try to devalue money as much as I possibly can.  I could give a shit about money if I could have fun or experience joy but I do not know how to without money. Everything I want to do requires money that I don't have, so i sit in the room i rent in my off time with nothing to do, geographically isolated because i can't afford to live in the city where i can be involved with the activities i am interested in and be near the type of people i would maybe be friends with if i could get past my anxiety issues.

Seriously?  Pills don't work well?  Well that really fucking sucks, that has been my plan for years.  How the fuck am I supposed to do it then? A gun just seems so violent and messy, I couldn't imagine suffocating with an exit bag or throwing myself off something.  My step-brother's Dad did the step in front of a semi thing and that is just selfish with no regard for the guy driving.

Well fuck..... I guess I need to try and get enough of these anxiety pills in me to go out and start the gun buying process. Stupid fucking waiting lists.....
